issues.description: Visibility of Animal.messageOnFeed() is inconsistent between the problem statement UML (shows a public method '+ messageOnFeed():String') and the solution implementation (declares the abstract method as 'protected'). This mismatch between the UML/specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the intended visibility and what signature they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent: either update the solution to declare the abstract method as public (public abstract String messageOnFeed();) so it matches the UML/specification, or modify the problem statement/UML to indicate protected visibility. The simpler fix preserving the UML intent is to change the method in Animal.java to 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();'.
